commands.command:
set -euo pipefail; OUT=/tmp/tracker-phase3-room-refresh-e2e-v2; PKG=io.blueeye; echo '--- FILES ---'; find "$OUT" -maxdepth 2 -type f -print -exec stat -f '%z bytes' {} \; 2>/dev/null | sort || true; echo '--- CURRENT DEVICE ---'; adb devices -l; SERIAL=$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}' | head -n1); test -n "$SERIAL"; echo pid=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof "$PKG" | tr -d '\r'); if adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys activity services "$PKG" | grep -q ScannerService; then echo scanner_service=present; else echo scanner_service=absent; fi; echo '--- CHECKPOINT180 ---'; if [ -s "$OUT/checkpoint180.json" ]; then python3 - "$OUT/checkpoint180.json" <<'PY'
import json,sys
d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); s=d['fieldMvpDiagnostics']['scanner']; i=s['ingest']
print('state=',s.get('state')); print('lastBleSeenAt=',s.get('lastBleSeenAt')); print('bleResultsPerMinute=',s.get('bleResultsPerMinute'))
for k in ('rawBleCallbacksTotal','enqueueAcceptedTotal','enqueueRejectedTotal','queueDroppedTotal','coalescedTotal','processingStartedTotal','processingSucceededTotal','processingFailedTotal','queueDepth'):
 print(k,'=',i.get(k))
PY
else echo checkpoint180_missing=1; fi; echo '--- BASELINE ---'; if [ -s "$OUT/baseline.json" ]; then python3 - "$OUT/baseline.json" <<'PY'
import json,sys
d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); s=d['fieldMvpDiagnostics']['scanner']; i=s['ingest']; print('state=',s.get('state')); print('lastBleSeenAt=',s.get('lastBleSeenAt')); print('raw=',i.get('rawBleCallbacksTotal'))
PY
fi; echo '--- RECENT BLUEEYE LOGCAT ---'; adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -d -v threadtime | grep -E 'io.blueeye|BleScanner|BleScanSource|ScannerService|Refreshing passive BLE scan|FATAL EXCEPTION|ANR' | tail -n 250 || true
